title: Keeping the Ball Rolling: Fullerene-like Molecular Clusters
claim: Polyoxometalate Keplerates can be assembled from twelve metal-oxide pentagonal units joined by thirty linker units, with linker choice allowing related spherical architectures.
explanation: The Mo-based examples share pentagonal (Mo)Mo5 building blocks, while Mo2, Fe, oxovanadium, and Cr-containing linkers appear in the reviewed structures; W-based pentagonal units have also been applied.
scope: The pentagonal-unit POM Keplerates reviewed in Section 4.2.
conditions: Generation of pentagonal metal-oxide units and their connection by compatible bridging units.
caveats: The formulas in the Markdown are partly corrupted; this card retains only the clearly stated modular counts and building-block identities. The W-based pentagonal units are reported as unstable in solution.
